name: popover
description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger or a PopoverAnchor, with placement, flip and collision control, closing on outside click and Escape
designIntent: Popover displays interactive content (links, buttons, forms) in a floating panel. The panel prefers the requested side, flips when that side cannot fit, and clamps inside the viewport, so it is never clipped by the window edge or an ancestor's overflow.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; flips to the opposite side when it cannot fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment of the panel against the anchor.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap in pixels between the anchor and the panel.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Nudge in pixels along the cross axis.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Minimum distance the panel keeps from the viewport edges.

props.name: matchTriggerWidth
props.description: Set the panel width to the anchor width, for select-like panels.

examples.title: Simple popover
examples.description: Popover with text and a button

examples.title: Placement
examples.description: The panel opens to the right and flips left when there is no room.

examples.title: Anchored to a field
examples.code:
<Popover>
  <PopoverAnchor><Input placeholder="Pick a date" /></PopoverAnchor>
  <PopoverTrigger>Pick</PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent matchTriggerWidth>
    <Calendar value={date} onValueChange={setDate} />
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
examples.description: PopoverAnchor places the panel against the field, not the wrapper.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Popover for plain text hints
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Tooltip for non-interactive hints. Popover is for interactive content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Popover for critical forms or destructive actions
antiPatterns.explanation: Popovers close on outside click, which can interrupt form filling. Use Dialog for forms and destructive confirmations.

antiPatterns.title: Don't build a custom floating panel
antiPatterns.explanation: Placement, flipping, viewport clamping, scroll anchoring and dismissal are already handled. A hand-rolled portal by definition has none of them.

accessibility.implementation: role=dialog with aria-labelledby linking to the trigger
accessibility.userRequirements: Trigger must have a visible accessible name

accessibility.implementation: Escape closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the trigger focusable after close

guidelines: Include at least one interactive element

compositionRules.relationship: Use PopoverAnchor when the panel belongs to a field rather than the trigger button
